name: comprehensive_benchmark_fleet_marketplace
description: Comprehensive benchmark for a fleet/mobility marketplace dataset. Tests cartesian product of 4 dimensions: adstock × train_splits × time_aggregation × spend_var_mapping (54 variants total). Designed for datasets with Google Search (brand/non-brand/pmax/display/video), Meta, Bing, Facebook sub-channels, CRM/newsletter organic channels, and context variables such as fleet availability, occupancy and location count. Dependent variable is typically 'bookings', 'gmv_net_eur', or 'gmv_gross_eur'.

spend_var_mapping.name: spend_to_spend
spend_var_mapping.description: All channels: spend → spend (direct cost impact). paid_media_vars equals paid_media_spends.

spend_var_mapping.name: spend_to_proxy
spend_var_mapping.description: All channels: spend → impressions (ad delivery proxy). Requires impression columns to be available in the dataset. Column order must match paid_media_spends in selected_columns.json.

spend_var_mapping.name: mixed_by_funnel
spend_var_mapping.description: Upper funnel (video, display, social) → impressions; lower funnel (brand/non-brand search, pmax, bing) → spend. Column order must match paid_media_spends in selected_columns.json.
